narrationScript: Welcome to Chapter 6.1: Introduction to Web Technologies, where we'll explore the foundational building blocks of nearly every website you visit: HTML and CSS. By the end of this chapter, you'll be able to understand the distinct, yet complementary, roles these two technologies play in web page construction. We'll dive into identifying and correctly using common HTML tags to structure your content, and then learn how to apply CSS rules to style those elements, mastering selectors, properties, and values. You'll differentiate between the various methods of applying CSS—inline, internal, and external—and crucially, you'll explain the CSS box model and its vital role in controlling element layout and spacing. Get ready to start building your first web pages!
deliveryNotes: List objectives clearly and with enthusiasm.
